🇬🇧 UK Daily Briefing | Sunday, 8 November 2026

1. ⚠️ Rise in Turkish nationals facing removal prompts Windrush accusations
Concerns have been raised over a sharp rise in Turkish nationals facing removal from the UK because of mistakes.

2. 🏘️ PM to write to councils on Armistice Day over veterans sleeping rough
Andy Burnham says veterans shouldn't sleep rough this Christmas.

3. 🏥 Campaigners say NHS birth centre closures are a 'shocking' denial of rights
Twelve midwife-led maternity units have closed in England since 2019, six of them since Labour came to power in 2024.

4. 🚗 Two people seriously injured in 30-vehicle crash on M20 in Kent
Emergency services attended the M20 near Hollingbourne in Maidstone after the incident was reported at 6.41pm yesterday evening.

5. 🇵🇱 Briton is among six killed in Krakow shooting described as 'far-right'
Polish police say the attacker randomly fired at people after driving on to Main Market Square in Krakow.

6. 👑 Royal Family join veterans and families at Festival of Remembrance
Senior royals attended the annual event at London's Royal Albert Hall on the eve of Remembrance Sunday.

7. 🎓 Nandy confirms UK will return to Erasmus+ scheme
The UK left the programme in 2020, when Boris Johnson was Prime Minister.

8. ⚽ Liam Delap scores twice as Nottingham Forest stun Manchester City 3-1
Liam Delap scored a superb double as Nottingham Forest beat Manchester City 3-1, securing their first Premier League win at the City Ground this season.

Sources: Guardian, BBC, Metro, The Independent, BBC Sport. Stories summarised from UK media reports. Images: Pixabay. Photos: Lauren Hurley / No 10 Downing Street / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons; Prime Minister's Office / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons; White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons; The White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons.

items.title: Rise in Turkish nationals facing removal prompts Windrush accusations
items.body: Concerns have been raised over a sharp rise in Turkish nationals facing removal from the UK because of mistakes. There are accusations the Home Office has not learned the lessons of Windrush. David Lammy is among those raising concerns.

photo.credit: Lauren Hurley / No 10 Downing Street / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: PM to write to councils on Armistice Day over veterans sleeping rough
items.body: Andy Burnham says veterans shouldn't sleep rough this Christmas. Downing Street says the prime minister will personally write to councils on Armistice Day to urge them to draw up plans.

photo.credit: Prime Minister's Office / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Campaigners say NHS birth centre closures are a 'shocking' denial of rights
items.body: Twelve midwife-led maternity units have closed in England since 2019, six of them since Labour came to power in 2024. Campaigners say the closures deny women the right to have a midwife rather than a doctor oversee their baby's birth.

items.title: Two people seriously injured in 30-vehicle crash on M20 in Kent
items.body: Emergency services attended the M20 near Hollingbourne in Maidstone after the incident was reported at 6.41pm yesterday evening.

items.title: Briton is among six killed in Krakow shooting described as 'far-right'
items.body: Polish police say the attacker randomly fired at people after driving on to Main Market Square in Krakow. The shooting has been described as 'far-right'.

items.title: Royal Family join veterans and families at Festival of Remembrance
items.body: Senior royals attended the annual event at London's Royal Albert Hall on the eve of Remembrance Sunday.

photo.credit: White House / Public domain, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Nandy confirms UK will return to Erasmus+ scheme
items.body: The UK left the programme in 2020, when Boris Johnson was Prime Minister. The announcement comes as the UK eyes closer ties with the EU.
